title: What’s New: Enhanced Document Reporting Features (For Developers) (2024 release wave 2)

Hide zeros and word section support

features.name: Word Add-in for Document Reports
features.description: A new Word add-in available in the 2024 release Wave 2 that enables using Word as the layout engine to produce documents. The add-in is installable from the Office App Store and provides new layout controls for document reporting.
caveats: The add-in is marked as preview in the current version but will be published as normal version when recording is watched

features.name: Developer Comments Layout Control
features.description: Allows developers to add hidden comments in Word layouts for versioning and documentation purposes. These comments are hidden from end users when the document is generated.
caveats: Comments are encapsulated using the insert layout comment action

features.name: Hide If Empty Table Layout Control
features.description: A layout control that removes an entire table from a document if there is no data in the repeater. This solves the problem of displaying empty table headers when no data is available.
caveats: Only works when the table has no data in the repeater; requires marking the full table and applying the hide if empty table layout control

features.name: Hide Empty Table Row Layout Control
features.description: Allows hiding an entire row in a table based on whether a specific field in the repeater is empty. Useful for removing rows where certain data is not populated.
caveats: Requires selecting the specific field in the repeater that controls visibility; encapsulates the field with hide table row if empty layout control

features.name: Hide Empty Table Column Layout Control
features.description: Removes an entire column from a table if there is no data in that column across all rows. Commonly used to remove discount columns when no discounts are applied.
caveats: Requires marking the header cell in the table and applying the hide empty table column control

features.name: Hide Field If Zero Layout Control
features.description: Removes a field from display if its value is zero. Useful for financial data where zero values should not be shown. Can be combined with hide column to remove entire columns with only zeros.
caveats: Can be applied to any field in the layout, not just fields in repeaters; can be combined with hide column controls

features.name: Word Sections Support for Merge Data Item
features.description: Word layouts can now use Word sections when the merge data item property is used to iterate over multiple items, such as creating multiple invoices. Sections can control margins, orientation, columns, watermarks, headers, and footers.
caveats: Previously sections could not be used in word layouts with merge data item property
Requires use of merge data item property
Only applicable to word layouts with iteration

features.name: Themeable reports with Office themes
features.description: Ability to apply Office themes to word report layouts, allowing users to change fonts and colors by selecting different Office themes in Word and uploading the modified layout back to Business Central.
caveats: Only for layouts specifically marked as themeable

features.name: Word alignment bug fix
features.description: Fixed a bug in word layouts where alignment in repeaters would change when downloading a word layout. Now alignment works as expected in word.

features.name: Planet PostNet and IMB font support
features.description: Added Planet, PostNet and IMB fonts to Business Central service to support barcode generation, particularly for US postal barcodes that can encode addresses.

features.name: Aptos font availability
features.description: New Office default Aptos font will be available in Business Central service by October to use in document layouts.
